limitations: Existing R2 train/dev is reused; this is development evidence, not an independent confirmation.
Known R2 test/OOD outcomes motivated a new objective; they are not scored or used to choose R3 checkpoints.
No new image encoder weights or model backbones are trained; only the shared residual projection is learned.
Primary and preservation ablation remain separate; only primary is automatically selected for prospective confirmation.
Dev superiority can be selection noise; no minimum gain or significance claim is imposed.
Catalog-image retrieval does not establish live glasses, physical identity, OCR, user learning or spatial registration quality.
Foundation encoder pretraining overlap with public ABO remains unknown.

protocol.anchors: each train row exactly once per epoch; at most floor(batch/2) anchors; additional candidates are never loss query rows
protocol.confirmation_candidate: primary recipe selection only; ablation never substitutes automatically
protocol.epoch_selection: dev alternate-view-to-gallery Recall@1, then MRR; identity wins exact ties; no minimum gain threshold
protocol.loss: symmetric image-image contrastive CE over anchors only plus recipe's optional cosine preservation
protocol.mining: train-only mean of both frozen image-image similarity directions; top4 other-family candidates
protocol.negative_policy: same-family nonpositive products masked; never promoted to positives
protocol.positive_pair: same product, distinct source-image SHA256 query/gallery
protocol.preservation_definition: mean across two anchor views of (1 - cosine(projected, frozen)); not coordinate-averaged MSE
protocol.seed_selection: same dev ordering; earliest fixed seed wins nonidentity ties
